documented_general_law: If b=0 return a; otherwise a-abs(b)*floor(a/abs(b))
host_representation: MIR i64 / C int64_t; wider than the language precision
unsupported: zero divisor (documented branch deliberately not implemented)

documentation.title: Digital Research PL/I-80 Language Manual

3.1.1.rules: FIXED alone is signed FIXED BINARY(15), two-complement range -32768..32767; precision is not storage width. Storage one byte for p<=7, otherwise two.

12.1.7.rules: MOD uses floor-based mathematical law, the specified zero-divisor branch, and common arithmetic result type.

documentation.limitation: Contemporary primary documentation; not blanket proof of linked compiler v1.4 runtime behavior.

confidence.DOCUMENTED: Arithmetic law, type/range/storage and result-type rule.
confidence.DEDUCED: MIR signed remainder equals documented MOD for admitted nonnegative/positive operands; no intermediate overflows in i64.
confidence.OBSERVED: Real upstream interpreter and x86_64 JIT agreement with independent repeated-subtraction reference on published cases.
confidence.UNPROVED: Actual linked PL/I-80 v1.4 runtime MOD behavior; all excluded arithmetic domains.

typing_provenance: Pass111 semantic-contract.json; compiler result ownership is separate from runtime evaluation
reference: OCaml repeated subtraction derives quotient and remainder; ascending multiples separately checks equality predicates.
lowering: One real MIR mod instruction followed by ret, with no imported arithmetic helper.
ownership: Scalar semantic inputs only. Fresh synchronous MIR context per call; no persistent state, buffers or callbacks.
guard: Abstract OCaml constructors and C pre-context guard; unsupported calls reject before MIR arithmetic.
integration: Experimental tools only; ordinary Dune builds and active compiler/native paths have no MIR dependency.
